question: How do I enable the OpenSSH server?
How do I completely disable root login over SSH?
reference: Set services.openssh.settings.PermitRootLogin to "no". By default root password logins are already disallowed.

question: How can I declare a user's authorized SSH public keys?
How do I give eth0 a static IPv4 address?
reference: Set networking.interfaces.eth0.ipv4.addresses = [ { address = "192.168.1.2"; prefixLength = 24; } ]; and typically networking.defaultGateway and networking.nameservers. By default NixOS uses DHCP (dhcpcd).

question: I'm running a web server, how do I open ports 80 and 443?
reference: The firewall is enabled by default; open TCP ports with networking.firewall.allowedTCPPorts = [ 80 443 ];

question: How do I turn off the firewall?
How do I open a range of TCP ports like 4000 to 4007?
reference: Use networking.firewall.allowedTCPPortRanges = [ { from = 4000; to = 4007; } ]; (UDP ranges use networking.firewall.allowedUDPPortRanges).

question: My last nixos-rebuild broke things. How do I undo it?
reference: Run nixos-rebuild switch --rollback on the running system, or pick an older configuration from the GRUB submenu "NixOS - All configurations" at boot and then make it the default with /run/current-system/bin/switch-to-configuration boot.

question: I edited /etc/nixos/configuration.nix. How do I apply the change?
reference: Run nixos-rebuild switch as root. It builds the new configuration, makes it the boot default and activates it in the running system.

question: How can I try a new configuration without making it the boot default?
reference: Run nixos-rebuild test: it switches the running system to the new configuration but does not make it the boot default, so rebooting returns to the old one.

question: How do I create a normal user account who can use sudo?
reference: Declare users.users.<name> = { isNormalUser = true; extraGroups = [ "wheel" ]; }; membership of the wheel group allows sudo.

question: How do I install a package like Thunderbird system-wide declaratively?
reference: Add it to environment.systemPackages, e.g. environment.systemPackages = [ pkgs.thunderbird ]; then run nixos-rebuild switch.

question: How do I install a package from the command line without editing my configuration?
reference: Use nix-env, e.g. nix-env -iA nixos.thunderbird. Run as root it goes into the default profile for all users; otherwise into the user's own profile.

question: Can NixOS update itself automatically?
reference: Yes: set system.autoUpgrade.enable = true; (optionally system.autoUpgrade.allowReboot = true;). This runs the periodic nixos-upgrade.service, which does nixos-rebuild switch --upgrade.

question: What is the difference between the stable and unstable NixOS channels?
reference: Stable channels (e.g. nixos-26.05) only get conservative bug fixes and package upgrades and are maintained until the next stable branch; nixos-unstable tracks the latest development.

question: The Nix store is eating my disk. How do I free up space?
reference: Run nix-collect-garbage (or nix.gc.automatic = true; to schedule it). nix-collect-garbage -d also deletes old generations, removing the ability to roll back to them. nix-store --optimise hard-links identical files.

question: How do I make garbage collection run every night?
reference: Set nix.gc.automatic = true; and nix.gc.dates, e.g. nix.gc.dates = "03:15";

question: How do I set up wifi without NetworkManager?
reference: Use wpa_supplicant with networking.wireless.enable = true; and preferably set networking.wireless.interfaces.

question: How do I enable a graphical desktop like GNOME?
reference: Enable the X server with services.xserver.enable = true; and enable a desktop manager, e.g. services.desktopManager.gnome.enable = true;
